title: Environment-Specific Skill Transfer for Decentralized Multi-Robot Navigation — reproducible code and data
description: Deterministic, seeded simulator, datasets, trained Behavior-Cloning model, and experiment/analysis scripts that reproduce every result and figure of the article 'Environment-Specific Skill Transfer for Decentralized Multi-Robot Navigation via Hybrid RRT and Behavior Cloning in Grid-Based Industrial Environments'. See README.md and reproducible/README.md for the full reproduction manifest.
